profile:
COMPANY NAME: Trex Company, Inc.
INDUSTRY: Building Materials / Outdoor Living / Composite Decking
PRODUCT OR SERVICE: Manufactures and sells premium composite and PVC decking, railings, and integrated outdoor lighting systems designed for residential outdoor living spaces.
TARGET CUSTOMERS: Homeowners planning deck or outdoor living renovations, as well as professional deck builders and contractors (TrexPro® network).
PRICING MODEL: Enterprise / B2B (Sold via authorized dealers and contractors; quote-based)
KEY FEATURES:
- Performance-engineered composite and PVC decking materials
- Integrated outdoor lighting solutions
- SunComfortable™ Technology for heat reduction
- Ignition-resistant PVC decking (Trex Refuge™)
- Online tools including cost calculators, visualizers, and contractor locators
UNIQUE SELLING POINTS: 30 years of industry-leading innovation, durability against sun and storms, sustainability (recycled materials), and a dedicated network of certified professional installers.
TONE & POSITIONING: Premium / Consumer-Facing / Lifestyle-Oriented
industry: Building Materials / Outdoor Living / Composite Decking
